title: Hermes Auto routing metadata envelope (v1)
description: The `_hermes_auto` object that the Hermes model-provider plugin injects into the request body via `build_extra_body()` (design.md §5.1). This is a private channel between the plugin and the local routing gateway: the gateway MUST strip the `_hermes_auto` key from the request body before sending the request upstream to any provider, so no upstream endpoint ever observes it. A `protocol_version` other than 1 MUST be rejected with an explicit protocol-mismatch error rather than best-effort parsed — a mismatched plugin and gateway disagree about the meaning of every other field, so silent tolerance would route on misread metadata. Unknown keys are likewise a version mismatch and fail validation, because this envelope is produced solely by the plugin and is never user-authored. This envelope carries routing identity only; it never carries prompt text, message content, tool arguments, tool results, or credential values.

protocol_version.description: Envelope protocol version. Pinned to 1. Any other value MUST be rejected rather than best-effort parsed.

root_session_id.description: The stable Hermes root session identifier (design.md §6.1). Sent raw over loopback only; the router hashes it with a local salt before it reaches any decision record or telemetry event (ADR-0004).

virtual_model.description: The virtual model the caller requested, e.g. `auto:balanced`, `auto:quality`, `auto:economy`, `auto:session`, or a configured auxiliary alias (design.md §5.1, §8.3).

plugin_version.description: Version string of the provider plugin that produced this envelope, used for compatibility diagnostics.

auxiliary_task.description: The auxiliary task alias when the call originates from a configured Hermes auxiliary entry — for example `compression`, `vision`, `title_generation`, or `web_extract` (design.md §8.3). Null or absent for a normal main-provider request.
